concentration.text: 20% aqueous methanol, that is methanol containing 20% water, as the dissolution medium

conditions.ph_target_stage: on the hot filtrate after the activated carbon has been removed, under temperature control, before the cooling and crystallisation

steps: hold the solution at the treatment temperature with the activated carbon for the stated time
filter hot to remove the activated carbon
add dilute hydrochloric acid dropwise under temperature control to bring the PH to 2
cool the filtrate gradually to 15 C so that the purified tembotrione crystallises out
filter to collect the purified tembotrione
workup.filtration: hot filtration to remove the activated carbon, then a second filtration after cooling to collect the crystallised product

purification: dissolved in 20% aqueous methanol at 60 C, treated with activated carbon for one hour and filtered hot, then acidified to PH 2 with 10% dilute hydrochloric acid added dropwise under temperature control, cooled gradually to 15 C and filtered to give purified tembotrione

compounds.addition_profile: taken as 5g of the crude product after the rearrangement had ended and its solvent had been distilled off, then dissolved in the aqueous solvent
the organic component of the 20% aqueous methanol that dissolves the charge; this is the variable under test in batch 7, and no amount is printed for it
the 含水 component of the solvent mixture, at the 20% water content in conditions.concentration; never named as a word of its own in this cell
1g added in one portion once the solution had reached 60 C, held one hour, then removed by hot filtration
10% dilute hydrochloric acid added dropwise (滴加) under temperature control to the hot filtrate until the PH reached 2; no volume or mass is printed

carried in the crude charge rather than added; the impurity this treatment removes, measured before and after in ppm and held as analytics on the A1 compound record, since no field here takes a ppm content
crystallised on cooling and collected by filtration as 纯化环磺酮; no recovered mass, yield or purity is printed

procedure_text: 重排反应结束后，蒸馏脱溶后取产品5g溶解在20%含水甲醇中，升温至60℃，加入1g活性炭保温一小时后热过滤，控温滴加10%稀盐酸调节PH为2，逐渐降温至15℃，过滤得纯化环磺酮。
procedure_summary: The crude tembotrione left after the rearrangement solvent was distilled off is dissolved in the aqueous solvent and warmed, held with activated carbon and filtered hot, then the filtrate is acidified with dilute hydrochloric acid added dropwise under temperature control, cooled gradually so the purified tembotrione crystallises, and filtered.

THE PROCEDURE IS A TABLE CELL, NOT PROSE. Example 2 prints no prose procedure at all: the only running text is the one-line lead-in at [0039], and every operation lives inside the 处理方法 cell of a table that is part of a page image with no text layer. procedure_text is that cell verbatim. Four records are emitted, not five and not two tables' worth: the two header rows are not records, and the fragment at line 204 is not a record either, it is the first half of batch 10's cell. THE FOUR BATCHES ARE PARALLEL, NOT A CHAIN. Each one takes its own 5g from the same crude material produced by the rearrangement, so no batch consumes another batch's product. precursor_step on all four is Synthesis Scheme::Step 2, the rearrangement whose product is the crude tembotrione, and no batch names another batch as its precursor.
